**gooddata-graphql** is a project in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md). Its code is written mainly in [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md) (71.1 %), with [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md) and [CSS](@/glossary/css.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 1 December 2016; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 19 December 2016. It reads “data result json”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2016, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/gooddata-graphql) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/gooddata-graphql).

Related work in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md): [czech-stats](@/work/czech-stats.md) (2020), [Crisis map](@/work/crisis-map.md) (2026), [microcrawler-couchapp](@/work/microcrawler-couchapp.md) (2014) and [apollocrawler.com](@/work/apollocrawler-com.md) (2014).
